name: Coconut Tropical Citrus Smoothie
instructions: This recipe will make about 8 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel the oranges and cut into quarters; place in blender.
Cut skin off pineapple, core, and cut into large pieces; place in blender.
Add the mango, coconut milk, and 4 ice cubes to the blender.
Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses and enjoy!
author: Mealime
